description: Hard UTF-8 byte cap on the rendered ledger: trailing whole entries dropped with a visible omission note, and a multibyte character shrunk char-safely (never split).
standards_text:
## Acceptance criteria

- first requirement with unicode ✓ marks and é accents
- second requirement MUST be short
- third requirement is long enough to push the rendered document past the tiny configured byte cap on its own with plenty of prose padding padding padding padding
